bootstrap.root_admission: Embedded root self-consistency is not institutional authentication. TEST never establishes LIVE authority.

status_rule: Historical issuance verification never implies current standing. A fresh independent signed registry check is required.
discovery_rule: An immutable capability/resolution identity locates a separately signed current service. Current service metadata never rewrites historical meaning.

admission.grant_binding: Exact key, role, signed payload hashes, namespace scope, operations and validity. No wildcard source or transition grant.
admission.source_locator: Within the same canonical repository namespace.
admission.issuer_scope: github-repository:* authorizes assessment under this profile only.

payment_binding: Standard x402 v2 exact EIP-3009 authorization, including client-selected random nonce. Durable atomic first association binds unique network/token/payer/nonce to exact request hash and purchase before settlement. Wallet signature authorizes a transfer, not authority or the request body.
purchase_identity: SHA256 of WHP-STANDING-PURCHASE-v1.1, root pin and cryptographically random 256-bit client_reference. No buyer key or authentication signature.

authority_admission.grant_binding: Exact key, role, signed payload hashes, namespace scope, operations and validity. No wildcard source or transition grant.
authority_admission.current_status: An ACTIVE registry snapshot requires fresh observations of the exact submitted manifest hashes. Changed, withdrawn, expired or inaccessible manifests limit current standing; issuance-time evidence remains immutable.
authority_admission.source_locator: Within the same canonical repository namespace.
authority_admission.issuer_scope: github-repository:* authorizes assessment under this profile only.
